name: RouteLLM routes simple calls to a cheaper model
gain: LMSYS's words: cost reductions of over 85% on MT Bench, 45% on MMLU and 35% on GSM8K, on the vendor's own benchmark.
how: Send calls through the router with a threshold chosen on your test set
trade_offs: Benchmarks aren't your traffic; needs a test set.
needs: A test set and a self-run router.
usage_signal: Usage and Cost API: one model holds nearly all spend across differently shaped calls
